section: Anti-Zamindari movements in Andhra - causes, leaders and outcomes
subsections: Prakasam Committee on the zamindari system - terms and report

accepted.s: In which year did the Madras Congress Ministry appoint the committee on the zamindari system, with C. Rajagopalachari as Chief Minister and Tanguturi Prakasam as Revenue Minister?
accepted.x: The Madras Congress Ministry appointed the committee in 1937. C. Rajagopalachari was the Chief Minister and Tanguturi Prakasam served as the Revenue Minister.
accepted.tq: Use the ministry-composition clue to identify the correct year and distinguish the Chief Minister from the Revenue Minister.
accepted.sec: Prakasam Committee on the zamindari system - terms and report

accepted.s: The formal constitution of the Prakasam Committee on the zamindari system took place in:
accepted.x: The committee was formally constituted in September 1938 and consisted of nine members.
accepted.tq: Pair the month and year with the membership figure instead of relying on the committee’s appointment year.
accepted.sec: Prakasam Committee on the zamindari system - terms and report

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. Completion of the report of the zamindari enquiry committee
B. Appointment of the committee by the Madras Congress Ministry
C. Formal constitution of the committee
D. Passage of the Madras Act that became one of the early abolition laws
accepted.x: The correct sequence is appointment in 1937, formal constitution in September 1938, completion of the report on 7 November 1938, and the Madras Act of 1948.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest events first, then place the two 1938 committee events in their proper order.
accepted.sec: Prakasam Committee on the zamindari system - terms and report

accepted.s: Which of the following was the principal conclusion of the committee’s report regarding the relationship between land, the tiller and the zamindar?
o: The State alone owned the land and the zamindar had no role in revenue collection.
The zamindar was the absolute owner of the land and the tiller was only a tenant.
Land belonged jointly to the zamindar and the cultivating tenants.
Land belonged to the tiller, while the zamindar was merely a tax collector.
accepted.x: The report held that land belongs to the tiller and that the zamindar is only a tax collector.
accepted.tq: Test the precise relationship stated in the report and avoid the swapped-owner and tenant descriptions.
accepted.sec: Prakasam Committee on the zamindari system - terms and report

accepted.s: What did Tanguturi Prakasam regret about the report of the zamindari enquiry committee?
o: That it failed to discuss the position of the tiller
That it did not identify the zamindari areas of the Madras Presidency
That it recommended continuation of zamindari without reforms
That it did not state outright whether zamindari should be abolished
accepted.x: Prakasam regretted that the report did not say expressly whether the zamindari system should be abolished.
accepted.tq: Look for the precise limitation of the report rather than assuming that its criticism of zamindari amounted to an explicit abolition recommendation.
accepted.sec: Prakasam Committee on the zamindari system - terms and report

accepted.s: Who led the yatra from Ichchapuram to submit a petition to the committee on the zamindari system?
o: Gouthu Latchanna and Pulleti Shyamasundara Rao
Pulleti Shyamasundara Rao and C. Rajagopalachari
accepted.x: Gouthu Latchanna and Pulleti Shyamasundara Rao led the yatra from Ichchapuram to petition the committee.
accepted.tq: Match the specific action and starting place with the correct pair of leaders.
accepted.sec: Prakasam Committee on the zamindari system - terms and report

accepted.s: Which one of the following best expresses the significance of the anti-zamindari agitations in Andhra?
o: They resulted in the establishment of the zamindari system throughout the Madras Presidency in 1948.
They led to the replacement of the Madras Presidency by a separate zamindari administration.
They helped make the Madras Act of 1948 one of the first zamindari abolition laws of independent India.
They postponed all legislation on zamindari abolition until the 1960s.
accepted.x: The agitations in Andhra helped create the political conditions in which the Madras Act of 1948 became one of the first abolition laws of independent India.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a historical significance statement from options that reverse the outcome of the movement.

accepted.s: Which organisation is associated with pioneering the demand for ‘land to the tiller’ and the abolition of zamindari?
accepted.x: The communists pioneered the demand for land to the tiller and for the abolition of zamindari.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive political demand to identify the organisation associated with it.

accepted.s: Approximately what proportion of zamindari land in the Madras Presidency was concentrated in Vizag, Nellore, the two Godavaris, Krishna and Chittoor?
accepted.x: About 70 percent of the zamindari land in the Madras Presidency lay in Vizag, Nellore, the two Godavari districts, Krishna and Chittoor.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact percentage before assessing the geographical grouping associated with it.
